description.zh: 业务类型，多个用竖线（|）分隔，全部填all。
description.en: The business type. Separate multiple business types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all business types.

description.zh: 待查询的域名，多个用竖线（|）分割，不传查询全部。
description.en: The domain names to query. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|). If you do not specify this parameter, all domain names are queried.

description.zh: 运营商名称，使用竖线（|）分隔，查询全部运营商填all。
description.en: The ISP name. Separate multiple ISP names with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all ISPs.

description.zh: 终端，使用竖线（|）分隔，查询全部终端填all。
description.en: The terminal type. Separate multiple terminal types with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all terminal types.

description.zh: 地域，使用竖线（|）分隔，查询全部地域填all。
description.en: The region. Separate multiple regions with vertical lines (|). Set this parameter to all to query all regions.

title.zh: 获取加速域名访客统计数据
title.en: Retrieve visitor statistics for accelerated domain names

descriptions.zh:
> - 不指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**时，默认读取过去24小时的数据；指定**StartTime**和**EndTime**时，按指定的起止时间查询。

- 支持批量域名查询，多个域名用竖线（|）分隔。

- 最多可获取最近90天的数据。
descriptions.en:
> - If you do not specify **StartTime** or **EndTime**, data from the past 24 hours is returned by default. If you specify **StartTime** and **EndTime**, data within the specified time range is returned.

- Batch domain name queries are supported. Separate multiple domain names with vertical lines (|).

- You can retrieve data from the last 90 days.
